verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships MemoryBench, a benchmarking harness (including a Claude Code skill) that compares a memory implementation against Supermemory, Mem0, and Zep on datasets you choose. Its docs also claim "State-of-the-art memory," but the evidence contains no published scores backing that recall-accuracy claim. This is a run-it-yourself tool rather than published results. Missing for 10: actual published benchmark numbers (e.g. LongMemEval or LoCoMo scores), named benchmark datasets, methodology write-up, independent corroboration of the results.
